title: Virtual Compute: portfolio threshold
content:
## Meaning — portfolio threshold

Virtual Compute portfolio threshold: Same-category posted pre-discount usage subtotal required within one billing entity and month for volume discount; USD decimal.

## Tier values — portfolio threshold

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — portfolio threshold: 25000.0.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — portfolio threshold: 25000.0.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — portfolio threshold: 25000.0.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — portfolio threshold: 25000.0.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — portfolio threshold: 25000.0.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — portfolio threshold: 25000.0.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for portfolio threshold?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has portfolio threshold of 25000.0.

## Meaning — portfolio discount fraction

Virtual Compute portfolio discount fraction: Discount fraction when the portfolio threshold is met; decimal.

## Tier values — portfolio discount fraction

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — portfolio discount fraction: 0.025.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — portfolio discount fraction: 0.03.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — portfolio discount fraction: 0.035.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — portfolio discount fraction: 0.04.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — portfolio discount fraction: 0.045.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — portfolio discount fraction: 0.05.
